title: Spending Tab and Guide
subtitle: A Spending tab for the month by category, the recurring bills and six months side by side; Start Here becomes the guide to the tracker; new tab order. One upgrade.
intro: After the pull requests merge, the code is already in your Sheet. The upgrade adds the Spending tab, rewrites Start Here and reorders the tabs.
**What does not change:** no rows, balances or entered values. Existing tab names and headers stay the same; Start Here keeps its name but its text is new.

steps.text: In the Sheet, open **File → Version history → Name current version** and name it `Before Spending tab 2026-11-10`.
Open **Finance Tracker → Upgrade workbook (keeps data)** and confirm.
steps.note: The report should include "Added tab: Spending". If it says the upgrade is already current, wait a minute and run it again.

steps.text: Check the tab strip: **Start Here, Financial Summary, Dashboard, Spending, Savings & Reserves, Debts, Goals**, then the rest as before, Reminders last.

sections.heading: Look at the two new pages

steps.text: Open **Start Here**. It now explains the tracker: the tabs in order, how money gets in, and the definitions (Spending Type, Need/Want, categories, what counts as spending, Parked for Bills, and more).
steps.done: The Definitions section is there and reads right for your household. Tell me anything you would word differently.

steps.text: Open **Spending**. The month follows the Dashboard's Selected Month. The category table lists this month largest first; the **Children** row shows childcare and child expenses together, with the two amounts in their own colours on the right and a two-colour bar. Below: recurring payments with Paid This Month, the flexible subcategories, and six months by category.
steps.done: Numbers match what you expect from Transactions. Rows for categories with no spending in the last four months are hidden; they appear when spending does.
